claim: The 440 original GGM-linked named fpw_* embedded RS source objects, completely source-body SHA verified, contain exactly 23037 source form records of 12 bytes each after 1347 independently byte-bounded segment header blocks. Applying only independently source-verified matching retail DLL SkillDataMan.ParseRSFData FormDispInfo input instructions to these original source bytes yields 23037 deterministic numeric *source-input decode* rows, not runtime object observations. Each original 12-byte form maps signed8 first two bytes to centerPos component inputs; (byte2 << 8)|byte3 to formIdx input; signed8 byte4 and byte5 each multiplied by 2 to formOfsPos inputs; byte6 to dispFrm; byte7 bits6..7 to formPri and bits3..5 to ringPri; byte8 initializes flags; byte9 conditional bit tests OR original masks 0x400,0x800,0x100 into flags and select source-labelled dir_LR/dir_UD bits and 3-bit altitude; byte10 bit5 ORs 0x200 into flags and bit3..4 supplies ringVibration; byte11 low6 bits supplies seID and high2 supplies seLevel; original effectID initialized with literal -1. The ordered 23037 decoded original source rows (GGM index/PathID/name/slot/form/source_offset and all 17 decoded numeric values) have SHA256 06c901a9d5f98eb37254b916a4916f077c1824b9bd833533ba064c50df6114bf, and independently previously proved concatenated raw source form bytes SHA256 93807a1a2d1208e693ef225d80598f3d1fb70f58d2a132d63fd052c97668ba18. Original numeric distributions include 7214 distinct formIdx inputs (100..37998), 43 distinct dispFrm inputs (1..90, zero absent), signed8 center_x -81..71, center_y -52..52, and doubled signed form offsets x -172..210, y -216..164. This is a reproducible *byte/parser arithmetic bridge* only: no specific retail asset runtime load, actual played frame count, pose transformation, coordinate units, sound output or gameplay effect established.
